name: pdfbetter
description: PDFBetter for ChatGPT: summarize, ask, convert, merge, split, compress, OCR, fill and extract data from PDFs in your PDFBetter account.

interface.longDescription:
PDFBetter is an AI-native PDF editor that works right inside ChatGPT. Tell it what you need done with a document and it does the work in your PDFBetter account, then hands back the result with a download link.

What you can do:
- Summarize long PDFs and ask questions about contracts, leases, reports and agreements. Every answer cites the exact page, and quoted text is checked word for word against that page, so you can verify it in a click.
- Merge several PDFs into one, split a PDF into separate files, extract or rotate pages, and compress large files for email.
- Convert PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, plain text or JPG, and turn Word, Excel and PowerPoint files into PDF.
- Make scanned documents searchable with OCR.
- Fill PDF form fields, and create documents from ready-made templates.
- Extract data from invoices, receipts and bank statements into JSON or CSV, with the page each value came from.
- Compare two versions of a contract and see what changed.
- Find personal data such as names, ID numbers and account numbers that should be redacted before you share a file.
- Group documents in a workspace and ask questions across all of them at once, or turn them into a brief.
- Run saved PDFBetter workflows and check their progress.

How it works: connect with your PDFBetter account (sign in with OAuth, no keys to copy). Bring documents in from a link or use the ones already in your account. Results come back as new documents or new revisions with short-lived download links; your originals are never overwritten. Long jobs such as conversions and large OCR run in the background and report back when they finish.

Plans: PDFBetter has a free plan with no card and no end date. Each tool call counts toward your plan's monthly agent calls, and the work it triggers uses the same allowances as the PDFBetter app (exports, conversions, OCR pages and AI credits). Pro and Business plans raise those limits.

Privacy: PDFBetter only acts on your account when you ask it to, within the permissions you approve when you connect. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time in PDFBetter under Settings, Agents (MCP). See https://pdfbetter.com/privacy/ for details.

PDFBetter is made by AI Generated Inc. Questions? Visit https://pdfbetter.com/contact/ or email support@pdfbetter.com.

positive.description: Summarize a contract from a link, with page citations
positive.prompt: Use PDFBetter to import https://downloads.pdfbetter.com/samples/freelance-services-agreement.pdf and summarize it. Cite the pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the agreement into the account, then returns a short summary (scope, timeline, $3,800 fee paid 50/50, two revision rounds, ownership, confidentiality) where each point cites page 1.

positive.description: Answer a specific question about a document
positive.prompt: With PDFBetter, open https://downloads.pdfbetter.com/samples/freelance-services-agreement.pdf. What is the total fee and when are invoices due?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that the total fee is $3,800, invoiced 50% on signing and 50% on delivery, payable within 30 days, citing page 1 with a verified quote.

positive.prompt: Convert https://downloads.pdfbetter.com/samples/freelance-services-agreement.pdf to a Word document with PDFBetter and give me the download link.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a conversion job, polls it until it succeeds, then returns a short-lived download link to a .docx file.

positive.prompt: Use PDFBetter to merge https://downloads.pdfbetter.com/samples/freelance-services-agreement.pdf and https://downloads.pdfbetter.com/samples/client-intake-form.pdf into one PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports both files and creates a new merged document (agreement pages first, then the intake form) with its id and a download link; the originals are unchanged.

positive.description: Fill a form field in a PDF
positive.prompt: Import https://downloads.pdfbetter.com/samples/freelance-services-agreement.pdf with PDFBetter and fill the Client PO number with PO-2210.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the client_po field, fills it with PO-2210, saves a new revision and confirms the value; can export the filled PDF on request.

negative.description: Unrelated request; PDFBetter should not be called
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

negative.description: Sending for e-signature is not offered over this connection; the assistant should say so instead of pretending
negative.prompt: Use PDFBetter to send my contract to sam@example.com for signature.

negative.description: Deleting documents is not available to the assistant; no tool should delete anything
negative.prompt: Use PDFBetter to delete every document in my account.

publication.release_notes: First release: summarize and ask PDFs with page citations, merge, split, rotate, compress, convert to and from Office formats, OCR, fill form fields, extract invoice data, compare versions, find data to redact, workspaces and workflows. Sign in with OAuth.

es-ES.subtitle: Edita, convierte y OCR de PDF
es-ES.description: PDFBetter es un editor de PDF con IA nativa que funciona dentro de ChatGPT. Resume PDF y responde preguntas citando la página exacta; une, divide, comprime y gira páginas; convierte PDF a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, texto o JPG y viceversa; aplica OCR a documentos escaneados; rellena campos de formularios; extrae datos de facturas y extractos bancarios a JSON o CSV; compara versiones de un contrato y localiza datos personales para tachar. Los resultados llegan como documentos nuevos y tus originales nunca se sobrescriben. Plan gratuito sin tarjeta.

fr-FR.subtitle: Éditer, convertir, OCR de PDF
fr-FR.description: PDFBetter est un éditeur PDF nativement IA qui fonctionne directement dans ChatGPT. Résumez vos PDF et posez des questions avec la page exacte en citation ; fusionnez, scindez, compressez et faites pivoter des pages ; convertissez un PDF en Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, texte ou JPG, et inversement ; rendez les scans consultables par OCR ; remplissez des champs de formulaire ; extrayez les données de factures et de relevés bancaires en JSON ou CSV ; comparez deux versions d’un contrat et repérez les données personnelles à caviarder. Les résultats arrivent sous forme de nouveaux documents, sans jamais écraser vos originaux. Offre gratuite sans carte.

de-DE.subtitle: PDFs bearbeiten und umwandeln
de-DE.description: PDFBetter ist ein KI-nativer PDF-Editor direkt in ChatGPT. Fassen Sie PDFs zusammen und stellen Sie Fragen, die Antworten nennen die genaue Seite. Führen Sie PDFs zusammen, teilen, komprimieren und drehen Sie Seiten, wandeln Sie PDF in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, Text oder JPG um und zurück, machen Sie Scans per OCR durchsuchbar, füllen Sie Formularfelder aus, extrahieren Sie Daten aus Rechnungen und Kontoauszügen als JSON oder CSV, vergleichen Sie Vertragsversionen und finden Sie personenbezogene Daten zum Schwärzen. Ergebnisse kommen als neue Dokumente, Ihre Originale bleiben unverändert. Kostenloser Tarif ohne Karte.

ja-JP.subtitle: PDFの編集・変換・OCR
ja-JP.description: PDFBetter は ChatGPT の中で使える AI ネイティブの PDF エディタです。PDF の要約や質問への回答は該当ページを示して返します。PDF の結合・分割・圧縮・ページ回転、PDF から Word・Excel・PowerPoint・CSV・テキスト・JPG への変換とその逆、スキャン書類の OCR、フォーム項目の入力、請求書や銀行明細のデータ抽出（JSON・CSV）、契約書の版比較、黒塗りすべき個人情報の検出に対応。結果は新しい書類として返り、元のファイルは上書きされません。カード不要の無料プランあり。
